parts.text: Which one of the following best describes **globalisation**?
choices: When a firm moves part of its production or services to another firm, often in a lower-cost country
The growing integration and interdependence of the world's economies through trade, investment, people and information
The country in which a multinational corporation sets up operations
Investment by a firm in one country in productive assets such as factories or businesses in another country

rows.answer:
Correct option: **B** (The growing integration and interdependence of the world's economies through trade, investment, people and information)
A: incorrect, that is the meaning of outsourcing
C: incorrect, that is the meaning of host country
D: incorrect, that is the meaning of foreign direct investment (FDI)

parts.text: Which one of the following best describes **free trade**?
choices: International trade that takes place without barriers such as tariffs or quotas
When a country can produce a good at a lower opportunity cost than another country
Goods and services produced in one country and sold to buyers in other countries
When a country can produce more of a good than another country using the same resources

rows.answer:
Correct option: **A** (International trade that takes place without barriers such as tariffs or quotas)
B: incorrect, that is the meaning of comparative advantage
C: incorrect, that is the meaning of exports
D: incorrect, that is the meaning of absolute advantage

parts.text: Which one of the following best describes **international trade**?

Goods and services produced in one country and sold to buyers in other countries

parts.text: Which one of the following best describes **protectionism**?
choices: A group of countries with free trade between members and a common external tariff on non-members
Selling goods abroad at a price below their cost of production
The use of barriers to trade to protect domestic firms from foreign competition
A tax placed on imported goods

rows.answer:
Correct option: **C** (The use of barriers to trade to protect domestic firms from foreign competition)
A: incorrect, that is the meaning of customs union
B: incorrect, that is the meaning of dumping
D: incorrect, that is the meaning of tariff

parts.text: Which one of the following best describes **tariff**?
choices: A group of countries with free trade between members and a common external tariff on non-members
A new domestic industry that is not yet able to compete with established foreign firms
A physical limit on the quantity of a good that can be imported
A tax placed on imported goods

rows.answer:
Correct option: **D** (A tax placed on imported goods)
A: incorrect, that is the meaning of customs union

A: incorrect, that is the meaning of tariff

parts.text:
The government of Novaris has introduced a quota on imports of sugar.

Explain one benefit of the quota for domestic producers of sugar.

rows.answer:
Award 1 mark for identifying a relevant point, 1 mark for developing it and 1 mark for applying it to the context.

Example:
- Less competition from imports (1) because the quantity of foreign sugar is limited (1), so domestic producers in Novaris can sell more and protect jobs (1)

parts.text: Which one of the following best describes **exchange rate**?
choices: An exchange rate set by the government or central bank at a particular value against another currency
A fall in the value of a currency against another currency in a floating exchange rate system
The value of a currency expressed as the amount of a different currency it can be swapped for
A rise in the value of a currency against another currency in a floating exchange rate system
